name: Pay.sh
summary: Pay your own GET /premium-data (or any x402 API) with the Pay.sh `pay` CLI, let Claude Code pay through it, and draft a Pay.sh catalog listing.

env.note: Your deployed https:// address, used in the Pay.sh catalog listing. Leave empty while you build locally.

prerequisites: The Pay.sh CLI: brew install pay, or npm install -g @solana/pay
